context: Business-analyst interview: Sakura interviews about the economy.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: journalist interview; commerce vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最近、消費の傾向はどうですか?
lines.style: professional adult interviewer voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 高額な商品の購入が、増えています。
lines.en: Purchases of expensive goods are rising.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ビジネスにも、影響しますか?
lines.style: engaged adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ええ、ビジネスの規模が広がっています。
lines.en: Yes — the scale of business is expanding.
lines.style: professional boss voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ドルの動きも、関係しますか?
lines.style: probing adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ドルが上がると、購入価格も変わります。
lines.en: When the dollar rises, purchase prices change too.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 消費のレベルは、戻りそうですか?
lines.style: curious adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 以前のレベルに、近づいています。
lines.style: reassuring boss voice, soft warm informative closing throughout
